ينتور (form VIII)
# يَنْتَوِرُ (yantawiru) /jan.ta.wi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَوَرَ (intawara)
# يَنْتَوِرَ (yantawira) /jan.ta.wi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَوَرَ (intawara)
# يَنْتَوِرْ (yantawir) /jan.ta.wir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَوَرَ (intawara)
